svg.title: Contrastive temperature
svg.desc: Softmax over the same similarities: tau 1 gives 0.26 for the match; tau 0.3 gives 0.57; tau 0.07 gives about 1.00.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Smaller τ sharpens the softmax and boosts gradients on hard negatives
